note: every action is its own texture on a 24 x 16 MeshPlane (art plan 5.3); anchors are wu offsets from the ground anchor (x right, y down); scale per frame from the area of the paint against the approved idle (or the body's thickness where the painting departed from its maquette), so every action keeps the idle's size

back.fall: the painting copied the idle stance (no buckling); held back: the back fall is the hit frame tilting into the dead frame (crossfade) in code
